description:
Use this when the user wants the last change to a clip or photo taken back: "undo that", "put it back",
        "I liked it better before", "go back one step". clip_id: from list_clips. Restores the version saved before
        the last edit and renders it again; calling again steps further back (RipClip keeps the last 20 saves for 7
        days).
        Not for: deleting a clip (done in RipClip) or a single setting (call the edit tool again with the old value).
        Costs no Horizon Units. Returns job_id: poll job_status, then preview_frame.
name: undo_edit
title: Undo the last edit
